title: C2: realism ladder: same tasks at text-only / simulated tools / empty sandbox / real-repo sandbox; plot eval awareness per level
body: Idea from the sponsor-use review (Exa + Modal). Extends the planned text-vs-sandbox demo moment into a graded comparison: run the same held-out seeds at four realism levels, (1) text only, (2) simulated tools, (3) real Modal Sandbox with an empty or minimal filesystem, (4) real Sandbox seeded with a real repo (real-repo-sandboxes). Report A1 and A2 at each level with seeds, sample counts, CODE_VERSION and cost, so we can see how much each realism layer reduces awareness. Depends on modal-sandbox-tools and real-repo-sandboxes. Paid run: needs the user's approval and a pre-registration before launch (AGENTS.md rules 4-5).
